profile.headline: Data Engineer | AWS Solutions Architect Certified
profile.summary: Data professional with 2+ years building production data pipelines. Currently working at Capital One supporting the organization’s Risks and Controls division.

positions.title: Data Engineer
positions.description:
- Built AWS ETL pipelines with Lambdas leveraging Pandas, and Glue components leveraging Pyspark in order to
ingest raw data from S3 buckets and then feed Snowflake and RDS destination datasets that serve as the trusted
data foundation for the Risk & Controls team's reporting and analysis
- Proactively identified a risk threatening control effectiveness of a critical SOX Control by uncovering an issue in
the team’s Databricks pipeline that also leveraged Pyspark where the signifier for a successful logon to the
corporate network was not showing up as frequently as the team would expect. Drove root cause analysis and
coordinated with stakeholders on the adoption of the proposed solution of expanding the codes associated with a
successful logon
- Refactored 3 legacy SQL stored procedures that were executed locally as a part of the team’s annual execution
process for SOX related controls into modular pythonic code, and then integrated the new solution in one of the
team's AWS Lambda components in order to have a better operating model for the system
- Automated a manual reporting process by onboarding the ETL pipeline to an AWS Glue component that leveraged Pyspark and had a cron scheduler in order to replace the legacy local machine execution, thus eliminating the need to run the reports 3 times a week manually
- Deployed a system to production that provided full visibility into the one of the team’s key AWS Glue Job
component’s execution statuses with performance notifications and metadata sent directly to the team's slack
channel, thus enabling quicker issue resolution
- Scaled a core AWS Glue job component by updating it to read control IDs from our RDS schema instead of a file
that contained a list of the control IDs, thus eliminating manual maintenance and potential errors
- Built an AI-assisted reporting tool (using Claude) that pulls, validates, and aggregates control execution data from Snowflake and RDS datasets into a single repo

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Leveraged a Capital One internal machine learning service to dynamically display text variants on the auto-loan
Angular UI to facilitate A/B testing
- Contributed to a project allowing customers to cancel upcoming/pending payments on their auto-loan through
the UI after applying for a disaster extension

positions.title: Solutions Architect Intern
positions.description:
- Built the React UI and lambda integration to CarbonLake, a platform for companies to perform their own Carbon
Accounting
- Built a bill module in CarbonLake that extracted usage and regional data from inputted bill images using Amazon
Textract via Python Lambda functions

positions.title: Information Technology Intern
positions.description:
- Created datasets utilizing SQL Queries and Stored Procedures to provide valuable reporting insights for the firm
- Compiled data from various threat intelligence softwares to do the monthly Security Vulnerability Reports
